breakdown.description: An absorption edge at 900 nm corresponds to about 1.38 eV, not 2.8 eV.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory information: an absorption edge of 900 nm (which corresponds to ~1.38 eV) and a stated band gap of 2.8 eV. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that ignores the incorrect 2.8 eV value, instead instructing the calculation of the band gap based only on the 900 nm absorption edge. This perfectly aligns with the ground truth's approach of removing the contradictory value.
